prompt: In a cozy living room, a plush gray sofa faces a wooden coffee table topped with a decorative bowl and a pair of hardcover books. A thick area rug lies in front of a stone fireplace where a scented candle flickers on the mantel beside a photo frame and a ceramic vase holding fresh flowers. To one side, a floor lamp stands next to a small side table that holds a table lamp, a television remote, and a steaming mug. A tall bookshelf lines the wall, filled with hardcover books and a woven basket on its lower shelf, while a framed painting hangs above the sofa. A stereo speaker sits on a console beneath a wall-mounted flat-screen television. A soft throw blanket is draped over the armrest, and two decorative pillows rest against the back cushion. On the rug, a content cat curls up next to a pair of cozy slippers and an open magazine, while a laptop computer is left on the coffee table. There is no gaming console, no plastic chair, no ceiling fan, no cardboard box, and no bicycle.
